ShortDescription.Value: Adjusts industrial building power consumption based on physical lot size and production efficiency

Publish.LongDescription:
# Realistic Industrial Power Consumption
Industrial areas are among the highest consumers of electricity. This mod introduces realistic, size-based power consumption for industrial buildings, ensuring that larger facilities place significantly higher demands on the electrical grid.
Power usage scales with building lot size, encouraging the use of substations and high-capacity power infrastructure. This integrates naturally with the growing ecosystem of substation and power line assets available on Paradox Mods.
By making electricity demand more accurate, this mod adds meaningful strategic depth to industrial planning and power management.
## Features - Lot size-based power consumption for industrial buildings - Efficiency scaling: Larger buildings are more power-efficient - Configurable global power multiplier (75%–375%) - Accurate electrical grid demand and consumption behavior - Compatible with all industrial building types - Optimized for minimal performance impact
## Settings Available in Options → Mod Settings
- Default: 100% (balanced gameplay) - Range: 75% (lower challenge) to 375% (high challenge)
Publish.ChangeLog:
**Version 1.2.1 - Size Category Customization**
**Added** - 7 size categories with individual multiplier sliders: Small (≤30), Medium (31-100), Large (101-250), Very Large (251-500), Huge (501-750), Massive (751-1000), Gigantic (>1000 tiles) - Adjustable multipliers for each category to fine-tune power consumption - Default values reduce consumption for very large buildings (prevents excessive power usage over 40 MW)
**Changed** - Very Large buildings: 80% default multiplier - Huge buildings: 60% default multiplier - Massive buildings: 40% default multiplier - Gigantic buildings: 22% default multiplier
